game.title: Dandi Biyo
game.description: Considered the oldest game in Nepal, similar to Gilli Danda. Players use a long stick (dandi) to hit a smaller tapered stick (biyo) and compete for distance.
howToPlay: Step 1: A small hole is dug in the ground or a circle drawn.
Step 2: Place the biyo across the hole with one end raised.
Step 3: Use the dandi to flick the biyo into the air.
Step 4: Strike the airborne biyo with the dandi to hit it far.
Step 5: Fielders try to catch the biyo before it lands.
Step 6: If caught, batter is out; if not, measure distance using dandi lengths.
Step 7: Batter scores points equal to number of dandi lengths.
Step 8: Players take turns batting and fielding.
Step 9: Player with highest total distance wins.
Step 10: Considered the national traditional game of Nepal.
